bullets.text: a pharmacy receipt in my coat pocket from a cold i don't remember having. the cold must have been polite.
duck still at okunoin under grey sky, leaf glyph. carried a line about doctors. the moss on the lanterns never booked an appointment.
reheating yesterday's miso soup. it tastes better today, which feels like a comment on me.
overcast inside and out, the soft kind. like a blanket nobody asked for.
